design_overview: A calm, trustworthy healthcare booking app with teal accents, card-based lists and a bottom tab bar. Patients can book in 4 steps: search, pick doctor, pick slot, confirm. Staff get a dashboard.

screens.name: Sign In & Register
screens.purpose: Let patients create an account, verify email, log in and reset a forgotten password.

key_components.name: Brand Header
key_components.styling: Subtle teal gradient, white logo mark and title 'CareBook', tagline 'Book hospital visits in minutes'.
key_components.interaction: Static; no action.

key_components.name: Mode Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented control with 'Sign In' and 'Register'; active tab teal with white text.
key_components.interaction: Switches the form between login and registration.

key_components.name: Full Name Input
key_components.styling: Rounded 12px field with user icon, placeholder 'Full name', visible only in Register mode.
key_components.interaction: Accepts text; validates on blur.

key_components.name: Email Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field, light border, placeholder 'Email address', teal focus ring.
key_components.interaction: Accepts email; shows inline error if invalid.

key_components.name: Phone Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field, placeholder 'Mobile number for SMS reminders', shown in Register mode.
key_components.interaction: Accepts phone number for reminders.

key_components.name: Password Input
key_components.styling: Masked field, placeholder 'Password (8+ characters)', show/hide toggle at right.
key_components.interaction: Toggles visibility; checks password strength.

key_components.name: Forgot Password Link
key_components.styling: Teal text link 'Forgot password?' right-aligned under password field.
key_components.interaction: Opens reset sheet; sends reset link to email.

key_components.name: Primary Submit Button
key_components.styling: Full-width teal gradient button, 52px tall, label 'Sign In' or 'Create Account'.
key_components.interaction: Logs in to Find Doctors, or sends verification email.

key_components.name: Verification Banner
key_components.styling: Green-tinted card: 'Verification email sent. Check your inbox to activate your account.'
key_components.interaction: Appears after registration; 'Resend' link re-sends email.

screens.user_flow: App launch opens this screen. Success leads to Find Doctors. Staff accounts go to Admin Dashboard.

screens.name: Find Doctors
screens.purpose: Search doctors by name, specialty or department and see who has open slots.

key_components.name: Greeting Header
key_components.styling: Teal gradient bar with 'Hello, Sarah' and a bell icon with red unread dot.
key_components.interaction: Bell opens Notifications screen.

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: White rounded 14px field with soft shadow, placeholder 'Search doctor, specialty or department'.
key_components.interaction: Filters the list live as the user types.

key_components.name: Specialty Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal chips: 'All', 'Cardiology', 'Dermatology', 'Pediatrics', 'Orthopedics'. Selected chip filled teal.
key_components.interaction: Filters doctors to the chosen specialty.

key_components.name: Filter Button
key_components.styling: Square 44px outlined button beside the search bar with a teal icon.
key_components.interaction: Opens filter sheet: department, day, gender.

key_components.name: Results Count
key_components.styling: Grey caption '12 doctors with open slots'.
key_components.interaction: Updates when filters change.

key_components.name: Doctor Card
key_components.styling: White card, 16px radius, round avatar, name, specialty, star rating and 'Next: Today 2:30 PM' green badge.
key_components.interaction: Opens Book Appointment for that doctor.

key_components.name: Save Doctor Button
key_components.styling: Icon-only 40px circle on card top-right, outlined; filled red when saved.
key_components.interaction: Saves or unsaves doctor as favorite.

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Shown when no doctors match: 'No doctors found' with a 'Clear filters' outlined button.
key_components.interaction: Resets filters and shows all doctors.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with 4 tabs: Doctors, Appointments, Alerts, Dashboard. Active tab teal with label.
key_components.interaction: Switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Arrives after login or from the Doctors tab. A doctor card leads to Book Appointment; the bell leads to Notifications.

screens.name: Book Appointment
screens.purpose: Show doctor details and available slots, then confirm a booking that cannot be double-booked.

key_components.name: Top Bar
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow, title 'Book Appointment' and a share icon at right.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Find Doctors.

key_components.name: Doctor Profile Card
key_components.styling: Large avatar, 'Dr. Amina Rahman', 'Cardiologist - 12 yrs', rating pill and department tag.
key_components.interaction: Static; 'About' expands bio.

key_components.name: Date Strip
key_components.styling: Horizontal day pills (Mon 12, Tue 13...). Selected day teal; days without slots greyed.
key_components.interaction: Loads time slots for the chosen date.

key_components.name: Time Slot Grid
key_components.styling: 3-column grid of pills '9:00 AM'. Open: outlined teal; selected: filled; booked: grey, disabled.
key_components.interaction: Selects one slot; booked slots cannot be tapped.

key_components.name: Reason Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line rounded field, placeholder 'Reason for visit (optional)'.
key_components.interaction: Accepts notes for the doctor.

key_components.name: Summary Card
key_components.styling: Light teal card: 'Tue 13, 9:00 AM - Dr. Amina Rahman - Cardiology'.
key_components.interaction: Updates live as slot selection changes.

key_components.name: Confirm Booking Button
key_components.styling: Full-width teal gradient button 'Confirm Booking', disabled grey until a slot is chosen.
key_components.interaction: Reserves slot; opens confirmation modal.

key_components.name: Confirmation Modal
key_components.styling: Rounded sheet with green check, 'Appointment confirmed', text 'Confirmation sent by email and SMS', button 'View My Appointments'.
key_components.interaction: Button opens My Appointments screen.

key_components.name: Slot Conflict Alert
key_components.styling: Amber alert 'This slot was just taken. Please pick another time.' with 'OK' button.
key_components.interaction: Closes alert and refreshes slot grid.

screens.user_flow: Reached from a doctor card. Confirming leads to My Appointments; back returns to results.

screens.name: My Appointments
screens.purpose: View upcoming and past visits, reschedule or cancel with the 24-hour rule.

key_components.name: Header
key_components.styling: White top bar with title 'My Appointments' and a teal plus button at right.
key_components.interaction: Plus opens Find Doctors to book again.

key_components.name: Status Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented tabs 'Upcoming', 'Completed', 'Cancelled' with count badges; active underlined teal.
key_components.interaction: Filters the appointment list by status.

key_components.name: Reminder Banner
key_components.styling: Amber-tinted card: 'Reminder: Visit with Dr. Rahman tomorrow, 9:00 AM'.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens that appointment's details.

key_components.name: Appointment Card
key_components.styling: White card with doctor avatar, name, date/time, location, green 'Confirmed' status chip.
key_components.interaction: Expands to show reschedule and cancel actions.

key_components.name: Reschedule Button
key_components.styling: Outlined teal button 'Reschedule' inside the card, 44px tall.
key_components.interaction: Opens Book Appointment with the doctor preselected.

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Text button in red 'Cancel', beside Reschedule.
key_components.interaction: Opens cancel confirmation modal.

key_components.name: Cancel Modal
key_components.styling: Sheet 'Cancel this appointment?', note 'Free until 24 hours before', buttons 'Keep' and red 'Yes, Cancel'.
key_components.interaction: Confirm releases slot and sends confirmation.

key_components.name: Late Cancel Notice
key_components.styling: Warning card: 'Cancellation within 24 hours is not allowed online. Call the hospital.'
key_components.interaction: Shown instead of the cancel action under 24 hours.

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered text 'No upcoming appointments' and a primary 'Find a Doctor' button.
key_components.interaction: Opens Find Doctors screen.

screens.user_flow: Reached from the Appointments tab or after booking. Reschedule leads to Book Appointment.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: Show reminders and booking alerts, and let users choose email and SMS reminder preferences.

key_components.name: Header
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow and title 'Notifications'; text action 'Mark all read' at right.
key_components.interaction: Marks every alert as read.

key_components.name: Filter Tabs
key_components.styling: Pills 'All', 'Reminders', 'Bookings'; active pill teal filled.
key_components.interaction: Filters the notification feed by type.

key_components.name: Reminder Item
key_components.styling: Row with teal bell circle, 'Appointment tomorrow at 9:00 AM', channel tag 'Email + SMS', unread dot.
key_components.interaction: Opens My Appointments.

key_components.name: Booking Alert Item
key_components.styling: Row 'New booking: John Doe, Tue 10:30 AM' with green dot; cancellations in red.
key_components.interaction: Opens related appointment details.

key_components.name: Cancellation Item
key_components.styling: Row 'Cancelled: Mia Chen, Wed 2:00 PM. Slot released.' with red tag.
key_components.interaction: Swipe left to dismiss.

key_components.name: Preferences Card
key_components.styling: Card titled 'Reminder preferences' with rows for email, SMS and a '24 hours before' option.
key_components.interaction: Groups reminder settings.

key_components.name: Email Toggle
key_components.styling: Row 'Email reminders' with teal switch, on by default.
key_components.interaction: Turns email reminders on or off.

key_components.name: SMS Toggle
key_components.styling: Row 'SMS reminders' with teal switch and phone number below.
key_components.interaction: Turns SMS reminders on or off.

key_components.name: Save Preferences Button
key_components.styling: Full-width teal button 'Save Preferences'.
key_components.interaction: Saves choices; shows 'Preferences saved' toast.

screens.user_flow: Opened from the bell icon or Alerts tab. Tapping an item opens My Appointments.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Let admins and doctors manage doctors, departments and availability, and view appointment reports.

key_components.name: Header
key_components.styling: Dark teal bar with 'Admin Dashboard' and a settings icon.
key_components.interaction: Settings opens role and account options.

key_components.name: Date Range Picker
key_components.styling: Rounded field with placeholder 'Select date range' and a teal 'Run Report' button.
key_components.interaction: Runs report for the chosen dates.

key_components.name: Report Stat Cards
key_components.styling: Three cards: 'Total 482', 'Completed 401' in green, 'Cancelled 63' in red, with no-show rate.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens a filtered appointment list.

key_components.name: Utilization Chart
key_components.styling: Bar chart of weekly bookings by department, teal bars with grey axis and legend.
key_components.interaction: Tap a bar to see exact numbers.

key_components.name: Doctor Management List
key_components.styling: Rows with avatar, name, department, 'Active' chip, and edit and trash icon buttons.
key_components.interaction: Edit opens doctor profile form.

key_components.name: Add Doctor Button
key_components.styling: Teal filled button 'Add Doctor' with plus icon above the list.
key_components.interaction: Opens form; saved doctor appears in patient search.

key_components.name: Department Chips
key_components.styling: Chips for departments with a final dashed chip '+ Add'.
key_components.interaction: Adds or edits a department.

key_components.name: Weekly Availability Editor
key_components.styling: Mon-Sun rows with on/off switch and start/end time fields; footer button 'Save Availability'.
key_components.interaction: Saves hours; new slots appear to patients within 1 minute.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: Same 4-tab bar; 'Dashboard' tab active in teal.
key_components.interaction: Switches between main screens.

screens.user_flow: Shown to staff after login or via the Dashboard tab. Receptionists see appointments only; admins see everything.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: Full-width, 52px tall, teal gradient, white 600-weight label, 14px radius, pressed state darker.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: Outlined teal 1.5px border, teal label, transparent fill, 44px minimum height.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: Rounded 12px, light grey border, white fill, teal focus ring, red error text below.

ui_components.name: Doctor Card
ui_components.styling: White surface, 16px radius, soft shadow, avatar, rating and next-slot badge.

ui_components.name: Time Slot Pill
ui_components.styling: Pill with 10px radius; states: open outlined, selected filled teal, booked grey.

ui_components.name: Status Chip
ui_components.styling: Small pill with tinted fill: green Confirmed, amber Pending, red Cancelled.

ui_components.name: Top App Bar
ui_components.styling: 56px bar, back arrow, centered title, optional right icon button.
ui_components.interaction: Back navigates to the previous screen.

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar with top border; teal active icon and label, grey inactive.

ui_components.name: Modal Sheet
ui_components.styling: White sheet, 20px radius, dimmed backdrop, clear title, primary and secondary buttons.

ui_components.name: Toggle Switch
ui_components.styling: 48x28 switch, teal when on, grey when off, label at left.
ui_components.interaction: Turns a setting on or off.

responsive_design: Mobile-first at 360px. Tablets use two-column doctor grids. Desktop shows a side navigation rail with a max content width of 1200px. Slot grids reflow from 3 to 6 columns.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, 44px touch targets, visible focus rings, labels on every input and icon button, status shown by text as well as color, screen reader announcements for slot changes.
animations: Quick 200ms transitions: slide between screens, fade-in modals, slot pill selection scale, toast fade, skeleton loaders for lists. Reduced-motion setting respected.
icons: Outline icons only, 24px, from the set: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. Teal for active, grey for inactive. No emojis.
